name: Ulta Beauty product hauls and store finds
what_it_is: Beauty creators film themselves at Ulta Beauty — a mobile "Campus Tour" truck activation, browsing the Ulta website for the Kylie Cosmetics Winter Kissed holiday collection, and smelling new fragrances (Diesel Only Desire, Dolce & Gabbana Devotion) — plus a sponsored Redken dry shampoo demo. The videos are individual product spotlights and store visits rather than reactions to one shared moment.
